texts: Fixed an issue that caused the Gifts page to crash when using card or full details display types.
Changed passive search to show multiple uptie/threadspin tiers together instead of as separate entries.
Added a button on the Company page to copy the share link to the user's profile.
Changed the announcement/notice that shows up at the top of the site to persist being closed across sessions. It will now only show up again when I've updated the notice.
Fixed an outdated section in the About page.
